findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp.etfiq.com" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: etfiq_page · Private data: etf_holdings, build_portfolio · Public sink: etf_search, etf_flows, list_benchmarks, compare_to_benchmark, build_portfolio, etf_compare · Destructive: build_portfolio, etf_promise.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: etfiq_page · Private data: etf_holdings, build_portfolio · Public sink: etf_search, etf_flows, list_benchmarks, compare_to_benchmark, build_portfolio, etf_compare · Destructive: build_portfolio, etf_promise

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
